name: Newer CheckNotExists cannot overtake older Put in product flush scheduling

payload.dangerous_low_level_shape: new proof-only generation reaches TiKV before an older value generation for the same key
payload.holding_guard: PipelinedMemDB waits for the active flush function before starting the next generation and documents non-concurrent flush functions
payload.sequential_result: later CheckNotExists after Put returns AlreadyExist and aborts
payload.reopen_only_if: a product path starts two generations concurrently or loses the prior generation completion dependency

provenance.source: client-go internal/unionstore/pipelined_memdb.go and TiKV flush generation handling

name: Ignored commit iterator error has no normal runtime producer

payload.source_shape: initKeysAndMutations ignores the loop-carried iterator Next error
payload.hypothetical_consequence: tail mutations omitted while commit succeeds
payload.holding_guard: RBT Next always returns nil; ART Next returns nil for every valid iteration and concurrent invalidation panics; commit construction has no concurrent MemDB writer
payload.reopen_only_if: a production MemDB iterator implementation can return a non-panic error after yielding a valid prefix

provenance.source: client-go transaction/2pc.go and unionstore ART/RBT iterators

name: Classify corruption only after terminal recovery owners

required: fresh durable row or KV state
invalid_reds: statement error expected but deferred to commit
payload.red: client success plus stable durable divergence after recovery

rationale: Generation differences are testable only after the product scheduler admits the order.
Owner differences become bugs only when they survive recovery into a wrong durable success.
